name: Differential Correction Targeter
description: Vary and Achieve differential correction over consumer-supplied propagator and parameter-evaluator ports.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each differential-correction or SQP iteration depends on the previous iterate and its supplied propagator evaluations. Independent solves remain caller-parallel; this artifact still compiles through the SDK's clang wasm32-wasip1-threads lane and spawns no guest thread.

methods.description: Validates a signed solver problem and starts Vary/Achieve or constrained optimization through the pull/supply ABI. Candidate states are evaluated by the propagator and objective ports selected by the consumer.
